decisions: CSharp EmitReferenceIndexPlace selects static/slice/dynamic runtime shape after loading a referenced source; element addresses use the live pointer and length.
SLG only classifies kind3 immutable local arrays as SSA records; kind4 fixed arrays fall back to a nonexistent mutable slot.
SLG also assumes array.i32 for descriptor loads and most extraction paths although fixed/slice containers use int_slice.
Use materialized indexed-owner shape for descriptor ABI and extend existing SSA value-binding handling to slice/fixed arrays; retain mutable-container pointer/length handling and checked indices.
Qualify immutable local primary/additional refs, a ref fixed-array parameter and a fixed-array struct field, plus the original16 rule vectors.
